invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of a Collectors.toList() terminal operation, which always produces a non-null list.
The input list is passed to HoodieListData.eager, which would throw a NullPointerException if hoodieRecords were null.
The method returns only those records from recordsWithLocation whose isCurrentLocationKnown() is false.
The result is a filtered sublist of the input records, so its size cannot exceed the input size.
If result is not empty, there was at least one input record matching the filter condition.
